about_the_game:
The Mystery of the Found Cassettes

You are an investigator at a local detective agency. The police have discovered several mysterious cassettes with unknown contents. Your task is to piece together the correct chronology of all the events recorded on the cassettes.

The author of these tapes...

You will not only immerse yourself in the investigation of the mysterious tapes, but you will also take on the role of the author of these tapes, who recorded everything on his VHS camera. You will find out what happened BEFORE and AFTER.

Features of your future investigation

  • A small but intricate analog psychological horror game full of secrets and mysteries, with a cruel and frightening nature...

  • VHS tapes telling the dark and truly mysterious story of an ordinary town resident, which changed his future destiny.

  • You will be not only an investigator, but also the author of the tapes.

  • You will have to piece together the chronology of the tapes yourself.

  • The tapes are shrouded in secrets and unexpected twists that even the author of the tapes did not notice.

What really happened in these tapes and why the police are concerned about these findings is something you will have to find out...
